newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sinopec opens $1.26 bln fibre plant.
newsitem.headline: China's Sinopec opens $1.26 bln fibre plant.

text.p: China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) has begun full operation at a 10.5 billion yuan ($1.26 billion) petrochemical fibre factory in northeastern China, the China Daily said on Tuesday.

The plant under Sinopec's Liaoyang Petrochemical Fibre Co had started full operation on Monday with production capacity of 260,000 tonnes a year, the official newspaper quoted Liaoyang Petrochemical general manager Yang Wentong as saying.
The plant, in Liaoning province's city of Liaoyang, would have sales of 4.3 billion yuan a year and generate 620 million in tax revenue, it said.

Liaoyang Petrochemical is one of China's four main manufacturers of petrochemical products, capable of refining 6.5 million tonnes of crude oil and processing 370,000 tonnes of chemicals and chemical fibres a year, it said.
